settings.description: Hearth & Harvest is a small-batch kitchen and grocery. Chef-made meals, snacks, drinks and desserts prepared fresh daily and delivered to your door in under an hour.
settings.head:
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com" rel="preconnect"><link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2" rel="preconnect" crossorigin><link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Fraunces:ital,opsz,wght@0,9..144,400..700;1,9..144,400..700&family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{margin:0;font-family:'Inter',sans-serif;color:#241610;background:#fff;line-height:1.6;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;overflow-x:hidden}
img{max-width:100%;display:block;border:0}
a{text-decoration:none;color:inherit}
ul{margin:0;padding:0;list-style:none}
h1,h2,h3,h4,p{margin:0}
::selection{background:#6B4226;color:#fff}

:root{--brown-900:#2B1810;--brown-800:#40251313;--brown-700:#6B4226;--brown-600:#875634;--brown-500:#A06A3F;--caramel:#C97C3C;--gold:#E8A765;--cream:#FBF6EF;--line:#EADFCE;--muted:#7A6555;--ink:#241610}

.container{width:100%;max-width:1200px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 24px}
.section{padding:96px 0}
.section--cream{background:var(--cream)}
.section--brown{background:var(--brown-900)}
.section__head{max-width:660px;margin-bottom:56px}
.section__head--center{margin-left:auto;margin-right:auto;text-align:center}
.section__title{font-family:'Fraunces',serif;font-size:clamp(30px,4vw,46px);line-height:1.14;color:var(--brown-900);font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.01em}
.section__sub{font-size:17px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:16px}
.section--brown .section__title{color:#fff}
.section--brown .section__sub{color:rgba(255,255,255,.7)}

.eyebrow{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--caramel);margin-bottom:18px}
.eyebrow::before{content:"";width:30px;height:2px;background:var(--caramel);flex:0 0 auto}
.section__head--center .eyebrow{justify-content:center}
.section--brown .eyebrow{color:var(--gold)}
.section--brown .eyebrow::before{background:var(--gold)}

.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:9px;font-family:inherit;font-weight:600;font-size:15px;padding:14px 28px;border-radius:999px;border:2px solid transparent;cursor:pointer;line-height:1;transition:all .25s ease;white-space:nowrap}
.btn svg{width:17px;height:17px}
.btn--primary{background:var(--brown-700);color:#fff}
.btn--primary:hover{background:var(--brown-900);transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 14px 28px rgba(107,66,39,.3)}
.btn--ghost{background:transparent;color:var(--brown-800);border-color:var(--line)}
.btn--ghost:hover{border-color:var(--brown-700);color:var(--brown-700);transform:translateY(-2px)}
.btn--light{background:#fff;color:var(--brown-900)}
.btn--light:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 14px 28px rgba(0,0,0,.25)}
.btn--outline-light{background:transparent;color:#fff;border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.45)}
.btn--outline-light:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.12);border-color:#fff}
.btn--lg{padding:18px 36px;font-size:16px}
.btn--sm{padding:11px 20px;font-size:13.5px}

/* HEADER */
.header{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:100;background:rgba(255,255,255,.94);backdrop-filter:blur(12px);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.topbar{background:var(--brown-900);color:rgba(255,255,255,.82);font-size:13px}
.topbar__inner{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px;min-height:40px;padding-top:8px;padding-bottom:8px}
.topbar__text{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px}
.topbar__text strong{color:var(--gold);font-weight:600}
.topbar__links{display:flex;gap:24px}
.topbar__link{font-size:13px;transition:color .2s}
.topbar__link:hover{color:var(--gold)}
.navbar__inner{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:36px;min-height:78px}
.logo{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:13px;flex:0 0 auto}
.logo__mark{width:46px;height:46px;border-radius:14px;background:var(--brown-700);color:#fff;font-family:'Fraunces',serif;font-size:22px;font-weight:600;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.logo__name{display:flex;flex-direction:column;line-height:1.1}
.logo__title{font-family:'Fraunces',serif;font-size:20px;font-weight:600;color:var(--brown-900);letter-spacing:-.01em}
.logo__tag{font-size:10.5px;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--caramel);font-weight:600;margin-top:3px}
.nav{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;flex:1 1 auto}
.nav__link{position:relative;font-size:15px;font-weight:500;color:#3E2C21;padding:9px 15px;border-radius:999px;transition:all .2s}
.nav__link:hover{color:var(--brown-700);background:var(--cream)}
.nav__link--active{color:#fff;background:var(--brown-700);font-weight:600}
.nav__link--active:hover{color:#fff;background:var(--brown-800)}
.navbar__actions{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;flex:0 0 auto}
.cart{position:relative;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;padding:11px 16px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:999px;color:var(--brown-800);font-size:14px;font-weight:600;transition:all .2s}
.cart:hover{border-color:var(--brown-700);color:var(--brown-700)}
.cart svg{width:19px;height:19px}
.cart__count{position:absolute;top:-7px;right:-7px;min-width:21px;height:21px;padding:0 5px;border-radius:999px;background:var(--caramel);color:#fff;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;border:2px solid #fff}
.mobile-nav{display:none;position:relative;margin-left:auto}
.mobile-nav summary{list-style:none;cursor:pointer;width:46px;height:46px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;color:var(--brown-800)}
.mobile-nav summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
.mobile-nav__panel{position:absolute;top:56px;right:0;width:264px;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:20px;padding:14px;box-shadow:0 24px 48px rgba(43,24,16,.18);display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px}
.mobile-nav__link{padding:13px 16px;border-radius:12px;font-size:15px;font-weight:500;color:#3E2C21}
.mobile-nav__link:hover,.mobile-nav__link--active{background:var(--cream);color:var(--brown-700)}
.mobile-nav__link--active{background:var(--brown-700);color:#fff}
.mobile-nav__divider{height:1px;background:var(--line);margin:6px 4px}

/* HERO */
.hero{position:relative;background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--cream) 0%,#fff 72%);padding:76px 0 92px;overflow:hidden}
.hero::before{content:"";position:absolute;width:660px;height:660px;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(201,124,60,.16),transparent 70%);top:-240px;right:-180px;pointer-events:none}
.hero__inner{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:64px;position:relative;z-index:1}
.hero__content{flex:1 1 53%}
.hero__media{flex:1 1 47%;position:relative}
.hero__title{font-family:'Fraunces',serif;font-size:clamp(38px,5vw,62px);line-height:1.06;color:var(--brown-900);font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.hero__title em{font-style:italic;color:var(--caramel)}
.hero__text{font-size:18px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:24px;max-width:530px}
.hero__actions{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:16px;margin-top:36px}
.hero__stats{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:40px;margin-top:52px;padding-top:32px;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.stat__value{display:block;font-family:'Fraunces',serif;font-size:30px;font-weight:600;color:var(--brown-800);line-height:1}
.stat__value small{font-size:18px;color:var(--caramel)}
.stat__label{display:block;font-size:13px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:8px}
.hero__frame{position:relative;border-radius:30px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 34px 70px rgba(43,24,16,.26)}
.hero__image{width:100%;height:540px;object-fit:cover}
.hero__badge{position:absolute;background:#fff;border-radius:18px;padding:14px 18px;box-shadow:0 18px 40px rgba(43,24,16,.2);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:13px;z-index:2}
.hero__badge--rating{top:26px;left:24px}
.hero__badge--time{bottom:28px;right:24px}
.badge__icon{width:42px;height:42px;border-radius:13px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex:0 0 auto;background:rgba(201,124,60,.14);color:var(--caramel)}
.badge__icon--green{background:rgba(60,134,84,.13);color:#3C8654}
.badge__title{display:block;font-size:14.5px;font-weight:700;color:var(--brown-900);line-height:1.2}
.badge__sub{display:block;font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:3px}
.hero__dots{display:flex;gap:8px;justify-content:center;margin-top:26px}
.hero__dot{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--line)}
.hero__dot--active{width:26px;border-radius:999px;background:var(--brown-700)}

/* CATEGORIES */
.cats{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:24px}
.cat{position:relative;flex:1 1 calc(25% - 18px);min-width:230px;height:310px;border-radius:24px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 12px 30px rgba(43,24,16,.12);transition:transform .35s ease,box-shadow .35s ease}
.cat:hover{transform:translateY(-8px);box-shadow:0 26px 52px rgba(43,24,16,.24)}
.cat__img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;transition:transform .55s ease}
.cat:hover .cat__img{transform:scale(1.09)}
.cat__overlay{position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(43,24,16,.05) 30%,rgba(43,24,16,.88) 100%)}
.cat__arrow{position:absolute;top:18px;right:18px;width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(255,255,255,.94);color:var(--brown-800);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;transition:all .3s}
.cat:hover .cat__arrow{background:var(--caramel);color:#fff;transform:rotate(-45deg)}
.cat__body{position:absolute;left:24px;right:24px;bottom:24px;color:#fff;z-index:1}
.cat__name{font-family:'Fraunces',serif;font-size:26px;font-weight:600;margin-bottom:5px}
.cat__meta{font-size:13.5px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.78)}

/* PRODUCTS */
.products{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:28px}
.product{flex:1 1 calc(33.333% - 19px);min-width:290px;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:24px;overflow:hidden;display:flex;flex-direction:column;transition:transform .3s ease,box-shadow .3s ease,border-color .3s}
.product:hover{transform:translateY(-7px);box-shadow:0 24px 46px rgba(43,24,16,.15);border-color:transparent}
.product__media{position:relative;height:225px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--cream)}
.product__img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;transition:transform .5s ease}
.product:hover .product__img{transform:scale(1.07)}
.product__tag{position:absolute;top:15px;left:15px;background:#fff;color:var(--brown-800);font-size:10.5px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.11em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:7px 13px;border-radius:999px;box-shadow:0 4px 12px rgba(43,24,16,.14)}
.product__fav{position:absolute;top:13px;right:13px;width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(255,255,255,.93);color:var(--brown-700);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;transition:all .25s}
.product__fav:hover{background:var(--caramel);color:#fff}
.product__fav svg{width:18px;height:18px}
.product__body{padding:26px 24px 24px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;flex:1 1 auto}
.product__cat{font-size:11px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--caramel);margin-bottom:11px}
.product__name{font-family:'Fraunces',serif;font-size:22px;font-weight:600;color:var(--brown-900);line-height:1.25}
.product__desc{font-size:14.5px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:9px;flex:1 1 auto}
.product__rating{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;font-size:13px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:15px}
.product__stars{display:flex;gap:2px;color:var(--caramel)}
.product__stars svg{width:15px;height:15px}
.product__foot{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:14px;margin-top:20px;padding-top:19px;border-top:1px dashed var(--line)}
.product__price{font-family:'Fraunces',serif;font-size:26px;font-weight:600;color:var(--brown-800);line-height:1}
.product__price span{font-family:'Inter',sans-serif;font-size:13px;font-weight:500;color:var(--muted);margin-left:4px}

/* WHY */
.features{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:24px}
.feature{flex:1 1 calc(25% - 18px);min-width:240px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.05);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.13);border-radius:22px;padding:34px 28px;transition:background .3s,transform .3s}
.feature:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.09);transform:translateY(-6px)}
.feature__icon{width:58px;height:58px;border-radius:17px;background:rgba(201,124,60,.2);color:var(--gold);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;margin-bottom:22px}
.feature__icon svg{width:27px;height:27px}
.feature__title{font-family:'Fraunces',serif;font-size:21px;font-weight:600;color:#fff;margin-bottom:11px}
.feature__text{font-size:14.5px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.68);line-height:1.68}

/* STEPS */
.steps{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:32px}
.step{flex:1 1 calc(25% - 24px);min-width:240px;position:relative}
.step__num{width:58px;height:58px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--brown-700);color:#fff;font-family:'Fraunces',serif;font-size:22px;font-weight:600;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;margin-bottom:22px;position:relative;z-index:1;box-shadow:0 0 0 9px rgba(107,66,39,.11)}
.step:not(:last-child)::after{content:"";position:absolute;top:29px;left:60px;right:-32px;height:2px;background:repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,var(--line) 0 9px,transparent 9px 18px)}
.step__title{font-family:'Fraunces',serif;font-size:21px;font-weight:600;color:var(--brown-900);margin-bottom:10px}
.step__text{font-size:14.5px;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.65}

/* ABOUT */
.about{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:68px}
.about__media{flex:1 1 47%;position:relative}
.about__img{width:100%;height:500px;object-fit:cover;border-radius:28px}
.about__badge{position:absolute;bottom:-26px;right:-20px;background:var(--brown-700);color:#fff;border-radius:22px;padding:24px 28px;box-shadow:0 22px 46px rgba(43,24,16,.34)}
.about__badge strong{display:block;font-family:'Fraunces',serif;font-size:34px;font-weight:600;line-height:1}
.about__badge span{display:block;font-size:12.5px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.75);margin-top:7px;letter-spacing:.05em}
.about__content{flex:1 1 53%}
.about__text{font-size:16.5px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:20px;line-height:1.75}
.about__list{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:15px;margin-top:30px}
.about__item{display:flex;gap:13px;align-items:flex-start;font-size:15.5px;color:#3E2C21;font-weight:500}
.check{flex:0 0 auto;width:25px;height:25px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(201,124,60,.15);color:var(--caramel);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;margin-top:1px}
.check svg{width:14px;height:14px}
.about__actions{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:16px;align-items:center;margin-top:36px}

/* CTA */
.cta__inner{position:relative;overflow:hidden;border-radius:34px;padding:78px 56px;text-align:center;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--brown-700) 0%,var(--brown-900) 100%)}
.cta__inner::before{content:"";position:absolute;width:460px;height:460px;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(232,167,101,.32),transparent 70%);top:-190px;right:-130px}
.cta__inner::after{content:"";position:absolute;width:380px;height:380px;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(201,124,60,.24),transparent 70%);bottom:-170px;left:-110px}
.cta__content{position:relative;z-index:1}
.cta__title{font-family:'Fraunces',serif;font-size:clamp(30px,4vw,46px);font-weight:600;color:#fff;line-height:1.14;letter-spacing:-.01em}
.cta__title em{font-style:italic;color:var(--gold)}
.cta__text{font-size:17px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.76);max-width:560px;margin:20px auto 0}
.cta__actions{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:16px;justify-content:center;margin-top:38px}
.cta__note{font-size:13.5px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.55);margin-top:24px}

/* FOOTER */
.footer{background:var(--brown-900);color:rgba(255,255,255,.68);padding:82px 0 0}
.footer__top{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:52px;padding-bottom:54px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.11)}
.footer__brand{flex:1 1 300px;max-width:350px}
.footer__brand .logo__title{color:#fff}
.footer__brand .logo__mark{background:rgba(255,255,255,.1)}
.footer__desc{font-size:15px;line-height:1.75;margin-top:20px}
.socials{display:flex;gap:11px;margin-top:26px}
.social{width:43px;height:43px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.2);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;color:#fff;transition:all .25s}
.social svg{width:18px;height:18px}
.social:hover{background:var(--caramel);border-color:var(--caramel);transform:translateY(-3px)}
.footer__col{flex:1 1 165px}
.footer__title{font-family:'Fraunces',serif;font-size:19px;font-weight:600;color:#fff;margin-bottom:22px}
.footer__links{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:13px}
.footer__links a{font-size:15px;transition:color .2s,padding-left .2s}
.footer__links a:hover{color:var(--gold);padding-left:5px}
.footer__contact{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:15px}
.footer__contact li{display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:flex-start;font-size:14.5px;line-height:1.6}
.footer__contact svg{width:17px;height:17px;flex:0 0 auto;margin-top:3px;color:var(--gold)}
.footer__bottom{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;padding:26px 0;font-size:13.5px}
.footer__legal{display:flex;gap:24px}
.footer__legal a:hover{color:var(--gold)}

@media (max-width:1080px){
  .hero__inner{gap:44px}
  .hero__image{height:460px}
  .about{gap:44px}
  .about__img{height:430px}
  .navbar__inner{gap:22px}
  .nav__link{padding:9px 12px;font-size:14.5px}
}
@media (max-width:940px){
  .nav,.navbar__actions{display:none}
  .mobile-nav{display:block}
  .section{padding:74px 0}
  .hero{padding:56px 0 72px}
  .hero__inner{flex-direction:column;align-items:stretch;gap:48px}
  .hero__image{height:400px}
  .cat{flex:1 1 calc(50% - 12px)}
  .product{flex:1 1 calc(50% - 14px)}
  .feature{flex:1 1 calc(50% - 12px)}
  .step{flex:1 1 calc(50% - 16px)}
  .step:not(:last-child)::after{display:none}
  .about{flex-direction:column;align-items:stretch}
  .about__badge{right:16px}
  .footer__top{gap:40px}
}
@media (max-width:640px){
  .container{padding:0 18px}
  .topbar__links{display:none}
  .topbar__inner{justify-content:center;text-align:center}
  .section{padding:60px 0}
  .section__head{margin-bottom:40px}
  .hero__image{height:320px}
  .hero__stats{gap:26px}
  .hero__badge--rating{top:16px;left:14px;padding:11px 14px}
  .hero__badge--time{bottom:16px;right:14px;padding:11px 14px}
  .hero__actions .btn{flex:1 1 100%}
  .cat,.product,.feature,.step{flex:1 1 100%}
  .cat{height:250px}
  .product{min-width:0}
  .product__foot{flex-wrap:wrap}
  .cta__inner{padding:56px 26px;border-radius:26px}
  .cta__actions .btn{flex:1 1 100%}
  .about__img{height:330px}
  .about__badge{position:static;margin-top:18px;display:inline-block}
  .footer__brand,.footer__col{flex:1 1 100%;max-width:none}
  .footer__bottom{flex-direction:column;text-align:center}
  .footer__legal{gap:18px}
  .step__num{margin-bottom:16px}
}
</style>
<style>
/* ===== SHOP PAGE ===== */
[hidden]{display:none!important}
.shop-hero{position:relative;background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--cream) 0%,#fff 72%);padding:64px 0 46px;overflow:hidden}
.shop-hero::before{content:"";position:absolute;width:560px;height:560px;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(201,124,60,.15),transparent 70%);top:-220px;right:-160px;pointer-events:none}
.shop-hero .container{position:relative;z-index:1}
.shop-hero__title{font-family:'Fraunces',serif;font-size:clamp(34px,4.6vw,54px);line-height:1.08;color:var(--brown-900);font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.02em;max-width:16ch}
.shop-hero__text{font-size:17.5px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:20px;max-width:660px}
.shop-catalog{padding-top:8px}
.shop-toolbar{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:20px;margin-bottom:36px}
.shop-search{position:relative;max-width:540px;width:100%}
.shop-search__icon{position:absolute;left:20px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);width:18px;height:18px;color:var(--muted);pointer-events:none}
.shop-search__input{width:100%;height:56px;padding:0 52px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:999px;background:#fff;font-family:'Inter',sans-serif;font-size:15.5px;color:var(--ink);outline:none;transition:border-color .2s,box-shadow .2s}
.shop-search__input::placeholder{color:#A8968A}
.shop-search__input:focus{border-color:var(--brown-600);box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(107,66,39,.12)}
.shop-search__input::-webkit-search-cancel-button{display:none}
.shop-search__clear{position:absolute;right:14px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);width:30px;height:30px;padding:0;border:0;border-radius:50%;background:var(--cream);color:var(--brown-700);font-size:14px;line-height:1;cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;transition:background .2s}
.shop-search__clear:hover{background:var(--line)}
.shop-filters{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px}
.chip{font-family:'Inter',sans-serif;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;padding:10px 18px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:999px;background:#fff;color:#3E2C21;cursor:pointer;transition:all .2s}
.chip:hover{border-color:var(--brown-600);color:var(--brown-700)}
.chip--active,.chip--active:hover{background:var(--brown-700);border-color:var(--brown-700);color:#fff}
.shop-catalog .products .product{flex-grow:0}
.product__foot{flex-wrap:wrap}
.product__actions{display:flex;width:100%;gap:10px}
.product__actions .btn{flex:1 1 0;min-width:0;padding-left:8px;padding-right:8px}
.shop-empty{text-align:center;padding:64px 26px;border:1px dashed var(--line);border-radius:24px;background:var(--cream)}
.shop-empty__icon{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:62px;height:62px;margin:0 auto 20px;border-radius:50%;background:#fff;color:var(--brown-600);box-shadow:0 8px 20px rgba(43,24,16,.08)}
.shop-empty__icon svg{width:26px;height:26px}
.shop-empty__title{font-family:'Fraunces',serif;font-size:24px;font-weight:600;color:var(--brown-900)}
.shop-empty__text{font-size:15.5px;color:var(--muted);max-width:440px;margin:12px auto 24px}
.shop-more{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:16px;margin-top:46px}
.shop-more__count{font-size:14.5px;color:var(--muted)}
@media (max-width:640px){
  .shop-hero{padding:52px 0 38px}
  .shop-hero__title{max-width:none}
  .shop-toolbar{gap:16px;margin-bottom:28px}
  .shop-search{max-width:none}
  .shop-filters{flex-wrap:nowrap;overflow-x:auto;margin:0 -18px;padding:0 18px 4px;scrollbar-width:none;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch}
  .shop-filters::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
  .chip{flex:0 0 auto}
  .shop-empty{padding:48px 18px}
  .shop-more{margin-top:36px}
  .shop-more .btn{width:100%}
}
</style>
<script>
(function () {
  var PRODUCTS_API = '';
  var PAGE_SIZE = 6;
  var state = { q: '', category: 'all', shown: PAGE_SIZE, cart: 0 };

  function onReady(fn) {
    if (document.readyState === 'loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', fn);
    else fn();
  }

  onReady(function () {
    try {
      var grid = document.getElementById('product-grid');
      if (!grid) return;
      bind(grid);
      if (PRODUCTS_API) loadFromApi(grid);
      apply(grid);
    } catch (e) { console.warn('[shop]', e); }
  });

  function qs(id) { return document.getElementById(id); }

  function bind(grid) {
    var input = qs('shop-search-input');
    var clear = qs('shop-search-clear');
    if (input && input.form) input.form.addEventListener('submit', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); });
    if (input) input.addEventListener('input', function () {
      state.q = input.value.trim().toLowerCase();
      state.shown = PAGE_SIZE;
      if (clear) clear.hidden = !state.q;
      apply(grid);
    });
    if (clear) clear.addEventListener('click', function () {
      input.value = '';
      input.focus();
      state.q = '';
      state.shown = PAGE_SIZE;
      clear.hidden = true;
      apply(grid);
    });

    var chips = document.querySelectorAll('.shop-filters .chip');
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(chips, function (chip) {
      chip.addEventListener('click', function () {
        Array.prototype.forEach.call(chips, function (c) {
          var active = c === chip;
          c.classList.toggle('chip--active', active);
          c.setAttribute('aria-pressed', active ? 'true' : 'false');
        });
        state.category = chip.getAttribute('data-category') || 'all';
        state.shown = PAGE_SIZE;
        apply(grid);
      });
    });

    var reset = qs('shop-reset');
    if (reset) reset.addEventListener('click', function () {
      state.q = '';
      state.category = 'all';
      state.shown = PAGE_SIZE;
      if (input) input.value = '';
      if (clear) clear.hidden = true;
      Array.prototype.forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll('.shop-filters .chip'), function (c) {
        var active = c.getAttribute('data-category') === 'all';
        c.classList.toggle('chip--active', active);
        c.setAttribute('aria-pressed', active ? 'true' : 'false');
      });
      apply(grid);
    });

    var more = qs('shop-load-more');
    if (more) more.addEventListener('click', function () {
      state.shown += PAGE_SIZE;
      apply(grid);
    });

    grid.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
      var t = e.target;
      var add = t.closest ? t.closest('[data-action="add"]') : null;
      if (add) { addToCart(add); return; }
      var view = t.closest ? t.closest('[data-action="view"]') : null;
      if (view) e.preventDefault();
    });
  }

  function matches(card) {
    var cat = card.getAttribute('data-category') || '';
    if (state.category !== 'all' && cat !== state.category) return false;
    if (!state.q) return true;
    var desc = card.querySelector('.product__desc');
    var hay = (card.getAttribute('data-name') || '') + ' ' + cat + ' ' + (desc ? desc.textContent : '');
    return hay.toLowerCase().indexOf(state.q) !== -1;
  }

  function apply(grid) {
    var cards = grid.querySelectorAll('.product');
    var matched = [];
    var i;
    for (i = 0; i < cards.length; i++) if (matches(cards[i])) matched.push(cards[i]);
    for (i = 0; i < cards.length; i++) cards[i].hidden = true;
    var limit = Math.min(state.shown, matched.length);
    for (i = 0; i < limit; i++) matched[i].hidden = false;

    var empty = qs('shop-empty');
    var more = qs('shop-more');
    var count = qs('shop-count');
    var btn = qs('shop-load-more');
    if (empty) empty.hidden = matched.length !== 0;
    if (more) more.hidden = matched.length === 0;
    if (count) count.textContent = 'Showing ' + limit + ' of ' + matched.length + ' product' + (matched.length === 1 ? '' : 's');
    if (btn) btn.hidden = limit >= matched.length;
  }

  function addToCart(btn) {
    state.cart += 1;
    var badge = qs('cart-count');
    if (badge) badge.textContent = String(state.cart);
    var mobile = qs('mobile-cart-link');
    if (mobile) mobile.textContent = 'Cart (' + state.cart + ')';
    var cart = qs('cart-link');
    if (cart) cart.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Cart, ' + state.cart + ' items');
    var original = btn.textContent;
    btn.textContent = 'Added';
    setTimeout(function () { btn.textContent = original; }, 1200);
  }

  function loadFromApi(grid) {
    fetch(PRODUCTS_API)
      .then(function (r) { return r.json(); })
      .then(function (data) {
        var items = Array.isArray(data) ? data : (data.result || data.products || data.records || []);
        if (!items.length) return;
        grid.innerHTML = items.map(cardHtml).join('');
        apply(grid);
      })
      .catch(function (err) { console.warn('[shop] products API unreachable, keeping built-in products', err); });
  }

  function cardHtml(p) {
    var name = p.name || 'Product';
    var cat = (p.category || '').toString();
    var price = Number(p.price || 0).toFixed(2);
    var desc = p.description || '';
    return '<article class="product" data-id="' + esc(p.id) + '" data-category="' + esc(cat.toLowerCase()) +
      '" data-price="' + price + '" data-name="' + esc(name) + '">' +
      '<div class="product__media"><img class="product__img" src="' + esc(p.image) + '" alt="' + esc(name) + '">' +
      (p.tag ? '<span class="product__tag">' + esc(p.tag) + '</span>' : '') + '</div>' +
      '<div class="product__body"><span class="product__cat">' + esc(cat) + '</span>' +
      '<h3 class="product__name">' + esc(name) + '</h3>' +
      '<p class="product__desc">' + esc(desc) + '</p>' +
      '<div class="product__foot"><span class="product__price">$' + price + '</span>' +
      '<div class="product__actions">' +
      '<button type="button" class="btn btn--primary btn--sm" data-action="add">Add to Cart</button>' +
      '<a href="#" class="btn btn--ghost btn--sm" data-action="view">View Product</a>' +
      '</div></div></div></article>';
  }

  function esc(v) {
    return String(v == null ? '' : v).replace(/[&<>"']/g, function (c) {
      return { '&': '&', '<': '<', '>': '>', '"': '"', "'": ''' }[c];
    });
  }
})();
</script>
